name: Alpinarium
kurzbeschreibung: The Alpinarium Galtür combines a monumental 345-metre avalanche barrier wall with a modern discovery museum and indoor climbing wall on the high-alpine habitat.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Alpinarium Galtür in the rear Paznaun Valley is a globally unique documentation centre and interactive museum: it is built directly into the village's colossal 345-metre-long and up to 19-metre-high avalanche protection wall. The striking structure was created as a direct civic response to the catastrophic avalanche disaster of February 1999, which claimed 31 lives. Located at an altitude of 1,584 metres, the centre unites respectful remembrance with an engaging exhibition detailing high-alpine living space, the culture of the Walser settlers, and how mountain communities cope with severe natural hazards. Designed by architects Falch, the exterior facade is faced with more than 20,000 tonnes of local natural stone and blends seamlessly into the alpine scenery. For its innovative concept, the museum was awarded the Austrian Museum Seal of Quality.

Route & Requirements

The permanent exhibition "GANZ OBEN" leads visitors through themed experiential rooms on a fully barrier-free tour. Multimedia installations, original historical artefacts, and moving firsthand accounts illuminate avalanche formation, alpine survival strategies, and the evolution of mountaineering. Generous ramps, step-free access, and spacious passenger lifts ensure unrestricted accessibility across all levels for wheelchair users and pushchairs. Indoors, an all-weather 70 m² bouldering wall welcomes climbers of all abilities. Normal sturdy street shoes are entirely sufficient for the visit. Outside, an asphalted panorama footpath along the protective barrier wall invites guests to an easy stroll lined with informative display boards.

Visit & Arrival

The Alpinarium welcomes visitors in both the summer and winter seasons from Tuesday to Sunday between 10:00 and 18:00 (closed on Mondays). Complimentary vehicle parking is available directly at the facility. By car, travel along the Inntal motorway A12 or Arlberg expressway S16 to Pians, then proceed along the B188 Silvretta federal highway past Ischgl to Galtür. Eco-friendly travellers can take ÖBB trains to Landeck-Zams station and transfer to VVT bus line 260, which runs directly to the Galtür Dorfplatz stop (two minutes' walk to the museum).

Tips

Relax after your tour in the in-house café "Gefrorene Wasser", featuring floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass windows looking out towards the rugged three-thousand-metre peaks of the Silvretta. Allow approximately two hours for your visit. Holders of the Silvretta Card Premium enjoy free admission.
preis: Adults €10.00, seniors/students €8.50, children (6–15) €5.50, under 6 free; discount with Silvretta Card Premium
oeffnungszeiten: June to mid-October and mid-December to after Easter: Tue–Sun 10:00–18:00 (closed Mondays)
